title: Phase-Space Analysis of generalised Fractional Anharmonic and Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Semigroups on Weighted Modulation Spaces
summary: We develop a phase-space framework for fractional generalised anharmonic oscillators and their heat semigroups on weighted modulation spaces. We consider operators of the form \[ \mathcal{H}_{k,l}=(-Δ)^{l}+V(x), \] where $V$ is a strictly positive homogeneous potential of polynomial growth of order $2k$. By studying a Hörmander metric adapted to the quasi-homogeneous symbol $|ξ|^{2l}+V(x)$, as in \cite{MR4299820, MR4944933} we place $\mathcal{H}_{k,l}$ and its fractional powers within the Weyl-Hörmander calculus.
